condition: recombinant homomeric Letter11 pore-deletion variant expressed and purified from E. coli; T=3 fraction of dimorphic population
notes: Directed-evolution-derived 11-residue deletion variant. Letter11 forms a dimorphic homomeric population containing approximately 70% T=4 particles and approximately 30% T=3 particles. This row represents the 180-subunit T=3 fraction and constitutes the first reported access to a latent T=3 architecture for QtEnc. PDB 9ZW4 / EMD-74905 was determined at 2.42 Å.
shell_sequence_change: 11-residue pore-loop deletion (Letter11 variant; same shell sequence as T=4).
shell_change_alignment_note: Curated Letter11 protein vs WT reference: 17 aa replaced by 6 aa, net shortening of 11 residues; same sequence for T=3 and T=4.
